summary: Gram–Schmidt on the frame vectors gives u ∈ 𝖴 with (ux)⁻¹f_a = f'_a orthogonal; the duality hypotheses bound 1/M ≤ ‖f'_a‖ ≤ M; completing with dual columns u(q) ∈ 𝖴⁰ gives an element of 𝖲·x in frameBox(M) with dual columns of norm ≤ M, and norm_le_of_mem_frameBox concludes.

steps.lean:
have d := gramSchmidt_def'' ℂ (frameVector x)
  set f := gramSchmidt ℂ (frameVector x)
steps.claim: Let f'_0, …, f'_ϱ be the Gram–Schmidt orthogonalization of the frame vectors x⁻¹f_0, …, x⁻¹f_ϱ; d: x⁻¹f_a = f'_a + Σ_{b<a} (⟨f'_b, x⁻¹f_a⟩/‖f'_b‖²) f'_b.

steps.lean:
have hu := liftUnitri_mem_besselU fun ⟨(a, b), _⟩ ↦ ⟪f a, frameVector x b⟫_ℂ / ‖f a‖ ^ 2
  set u := liftUnitri _
steps.claim: Let u = liftUnitri of the upper unitriangular matrix with entries ⟨f'_a, x⁻¹f_b⟩/‖f'_a‖² (a < b); u ∈ 𝖴.

steps.lean:
have e : frameVector (u * x) = f :=
    funext (WellFoundedLT.fix fun b i ↦ by simpa +contextual [u, i, unitriMatrix,
    (add_comm (f b)), sum_ite, filter_gt_eq_Iio] using (frameVector_eq_sum b hu).symm.trans (d b))
steps.claim: e: frameVector(ux, b) = f'_b for every b, by well-founded induction on b from frameVector_eq_sum and d.

steps.lean:
have l a : 1 ≤ ‖f a‖ * M := by grw [← n (2 * 𝔰.ϱ - a), ← norm_inner_J₁_le, ← e,
    frameVector_eq_sum a (inv_mem
    hu), sum_inner, sum_eq_single a (lt_or_ge · a |>.rec ?_ ?_)] <;> simp +contextual (disch := lia)
    [↓frameMatrix_unitriangular (inv_mem hu), inner_smul_left, *]
steps.claim: l: 1 ≤ ‖f'_a‖·M for every a: f'_a = (ux)⁻¹f_a = Σ_b frameMatrix(u⁻¹)_{ba} x⁻¹f_b with frameMatrix(u⁻¹) unitriangular, so ⟨V_{2ϱ−a}, J₁(𝔰)f'_a⟩ = ⟨V_{2ϱ−a}, J₁(𝔰)V_a⟩ = −1 (the terms b < a vanish by k, the terms b > a have coefficient 0); hence 1 ≤ ‖V_{2ϱ−a}‖‖f'_a‖ ≤ M‖f'_a‖ (norm_inner_J₁(𝔰)_le, n).

steps.lean: have z a : 0 < ‖f a‖ := by nlinarith [l a]

replace d a : ‖f a‖ ≤ M := le_of_mul_le_mul_left (by
    grw [← n a (by lia), ← h, ← @norm_inner_le_norm ℂ, d]; simp +contextual [f, ← mem_Iio,
    ne_of_gt, gramSchmidt_orthogonal, sq, inner_add_right, inner_sum, inner_smul_right]) (z a)
steps.claim: ‖f'_a‖ ≤ M: ‖f'_a‖² = ⟨f'_a, x⁻¹f_a⟩ (the f'_b are orthogonal) ≤ ‖f'_a‖‖V_a‖ ≤ ‖f'_a‖M (h, n); divide by ‖f'_a‖ > 0.

steps.lean: let v a := ‖f a‖⁻¹ ^ 2 • f a
steps.claim: Let v_a = ‖f'_a‖⁻²·f'_a (so ⟨f'_a, v_b⟩ = δ_{ab} and ‖v_a‖ = ‖f'_a‖⁻¹ ≤ M).

steps.lean:
have ⟨q, k⟩ := (by simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc, mul_mul_eq_of_mul_eq IsHermInvolution.mul_self,
    mul_inclMatrix, Matrix.one_mul] using
    (@exists_mul_unipotentOf_dualCols_eq _ (u * x)⁻¹ (𝔰.J₁ * (of (v ·.castSucc ·))ᵀ)) :) ?_ ?_
steps.claim: There is q with (ux)⁻¹u(q)e*_b = J₁(𝔰)v_b for every pair index b < ϱ (u(q) = unipotentOf(q) ∈ 𝖴⁰), by exists_mul_unipotentOf_dualCols_eq applied to s = (ux)⁻¹ and the columns J₁(𝔰)v_b — provided the columns are dual to the frame (8.1) and isotropic (8.2), the two goals left open here.

steps.lean:
exact besselSize_besselS_mul (mem_unitriGroup_of_mem_besselU hu) ▸
    (besselSize_le (mem_unitriGroup_of_mem_besselU (inv_mem (unipotentOf_mem_besselU0 q).1))).trans
    (norm_le_of_mem_frameBox _ (by simp_all [frameBox, frameVector_mul, mem_sup_left,
    unipotentOf_mem_besselU0]) hM fun j ↦ .trans (congr(‖toLp 2
    ($kᵀ j)‖).trans_le (l2_opNorm_mulVec _ (v _))) (by simp [*, v, norm_smul, field]))
steps.claim: besselSize(x) = besselSize(ux) ≤ ‖u(q)⁻¹ux‖ + 1 (u, u(q)⁻¹ ∈ 𝖲); the element y = u(q)⁻¹ux has frame vectors y⁻¹f_a = (ux)⁻¹f_a = f'_a of norm ≤ M (u(q) fixes the frame) and dual columns y⁻¹e*_b = J₁(𝔰)v_b of norm ≤ ‖v_b‖ ≤ M (l); so ‖y‖ + 1 ≤ 8(ϱ+1)M by norm_le_of_mem_frameBox.
The two open goals of step 8 are identities of matrices, checked entry by entry as inner products.
